visual_mismatch_ledger.observation: Leveling the crest removed the strongest point, but the generic closed-shell operation still fills the exterior side boundary. The reference is an open-underbody A-frame, not a solid triangular side wall.
The artifact has continuous all-quad topology but uses the wrong physical construction abstraction for this product.

technical_observations.rejection_reason: closed-manifold requirement conflicts with observed open A-frame construction

required_next_action: Use one connected open surface cage with selective top-boundary bridging, then use an unapplied Solidify modifier only after silhouette review.
disposition_boundary: Rejected for reference mismatch despite valid manifold topology.
